summary: Materialized a non-authoritative CANARY three-block state/intelligence/communication contract and deterministic harness. The contract maps existing CURRENT owners for durable human intent, worker signals, claim frontier/recovery pressure, capacity policy, returns, chat recovery/history, Primary Chat projection and E0-E9/E9 telemetry. It defines deterministic state precedence, template-first responses, time metrics that remain UNKNOWN when timestamps are missing, and a human-idle rule driven only by durable human action. Harness passes stale projection, decision boundary, claim transport degraded, no-capacity human intent, returns, recovery, REFILL, low buffer, workers active, campaign complete and >1h human-idle cases. Renderer wiring and daily projection remain pending.
